verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that mail is scanned to PDF, uploaded to the account and kept in unlimited online storage. Nothing in the pack mentions OCR, text extraction or search of the archive by sender, content or date. Scanning and storage are adjacent features, not the searchable OCR archive this story asks for.

support.subject: As an operator, scans are OCR'd and my mail archive is searchable by sender, content, and date
